rationale: Motor-vehicle collision with damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder resulting from impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday by a vehicle traveling 35 mph. The vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and back-seat damage. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking; trunk crushed into back seat
